pages.title: 국립중앙도서관

observation.method: Read-only Playwright Chromium navigation; manually reviewed primitive-string visible-control extracts, safe attributes, absolute hrefs and ancestor context. Screenshot review additionally performed on library-search and library-help.
conditions: Fresh anonymous headless Chromium context; no login, hover, user data entry, download or form submission.
Controls had CSS layout boxes and visibility was not hidden at 1440x1080; below-fold controls are included.
limitations: Manually reconstructed public-menu subset only; not a full DOM/page copy or live extension-click validation.
Original div-based header/footer/container context is retained without adding semantic header/main/footer landmarks. Minimal styling does not reproduce geometry, images, overlays or scripts.

Script-backed controls are original-control locate only. Third-party event-handler implementations are omitted; library-home-tip retains only an inert local onclick="return false" presence marker. Popup behavior is not simulated.

Initial object-returning page.evaluate extracts were undefined; title, body locator and primitive-string extracts worked without changing security or certificate settings. The extraction-method anomaly is not treated as a site access failure.

task.instruction: 첫 화면의 검색어 입력 제어를 찾아 원본 위치로 안내받으세요. 입력하거나 검색하지 않습니다.
task.boundary: public link or original control reach only; no form submit

notes: 로그인 원본 링크는 javascript:anyidAdaptor.ssoLoginPage(...)이므로 locate. 인증은 수행하지 않음.
검색방법 ? 링크는 href=#이지만 aria-label=search_tip인 원본 팝업 제어이며 단순 앵커 이동으로 판정하지 않음.

Fixture v1.1 fidelity correction: library-home-tip preserves the observed raw href="#" and onclick attribute presence with the inert local marker onclick="return false". Original third-party handler code is not copied. Truth labels, expected/accepted groups, task, counts and split are unchanged. See docs/evidence/run001/fixture-correction-v1.1.json.
